bugs.name: Saving a still-open editor for a page deleted in another tab silently recreates the page
bugs.summary: The stale editor saves without any warning and the page is back: the address /eval/harbor-handbook/wiki/agent13-race.- now shows the new body \"Race v2 after delete\" with \"3\" revisions. The revision history then reads \"Update agent13-race\" (now) on top of \"Delete page \"agent13-race.-\"\" and \"Add agent13-race\", so a page the person deleted comes back to life with content written after the delete, and nothing told the person editing that the page no longer existed. (on /eval/harbor-handbook/wiki/agent13-race.-?action=_edit)
bugs.expected: Saving from an editor opened before the page was deleted should either be refused with a clear message (\"this page has been deleted in the meantime\") or ask the person what to do; it must not silently recreate the deleted page.
bugs.actual: The stale editor saves without any warning and the page is back: the address /eval/harbor-handbook/wiki/agent13-race.- now shows the new body \"Race v2 after delete\" with \"3\" revisions. The revision history then reads \"Update agent13-race\" (now) on top of \"Delete page \"agent13-race.-\"\" and \"Add agent13-race\", so a page the person deleted comes back to life with content written after the delete, and nothing told the person editing that the page no longer existed.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval and create a wiki page of your own via /eval/harbor-handbook/wiki?action=_new with the title agent13-race and the body "# Race v1" (it is saved as /eval/harbor-handbook/wiki/agent13-race.-).
Open its editor in a second tab: /eval/harbor-handbook/wiki/agent13-race.-?action=_edit and leave it open.
In the first tab open the page view /eval/harbor-handbook/wiki/agent13-race.- and delete the page with "Delete Page" then "Yes": the wiki falls back to the Home page.
Back in the editor tab (still showing the old body) type "# Race v2 after delete" and click "Save Page".
The save succeeds with no warning and the page is shown again as "Race v2 after delete" with 3 revisions; its history lists "Update agent13-race" above "Delete page "agent13-race.-"".
